items.followUp: Define software piracy and explain any two types of software piracy.

rubric.why: This identifies software piracy as copying software without authorization.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that copying, use, or distribution of software without permission is piracy.

rubric.why: Softlifting involves making or sharing unauthorized copies of software.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming softlifting and describing its unauthorized copying or sharing.

rubric.why: Hard-disk loading is the unauthorized installation of software on computers sold to customers.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming hard-disk loading and explaining the unauthorized installation on computers for sale.

rubric.why: Online piracy involves obtaining or distributing software online without permission.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming online piracy and describing unauthorized online downloading or distribution.

modelAnswer: Software piracy is the unauthorized copying, use, or distribution of software.
Softlifting is making or sharing unauthorized copies of software.
Hard-disk loading is installing unauthorized software on computers for sale.
Online piracy is downloading or distributing software online without permission.

items.followUp: What is a prototype, and what does it represent?

rubric.why: A prototype is an early version or model.
rubric.description: Identifies a prototype as an early model.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing it as an initial or preliminary model.

rubric.why: A prototype models a product or system and shows how its design will work.
rubric.description: States what the prototype models or demonstrates.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it represents a product or system or demonstrates how its design will work.

modelAnswer: A prototype is an initial or preliminary working model of a product or system.
It shows how the design will work.

items.followUp: What does HTML stand for, and how is it used to create web pages?

rubric.why: This is the correct full form of HTML.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for writing the correct full form.

rubric.why: HTML markup tags are used to create or structure web pages.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning that HTML is used to create or structure web pages.

modelAnswer: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language.
It is a markup language used to create and structure web pages with tags.
